title: PMO and Board surface clarity
acceptance: PMO Teams Topic opens as one compact, legible surface with a small identity header and no oversized title band.
Board's left tool panel renders Demand summaries and an explicit empty state; it never renders Branch names as Demand rows.
Board's explicit New Demand action persists a Demand before opening the canonical PMO Teams Topic with that Demand context; direct PMO chat keeps creation under PMO clarification and confirmation.
Board tool chrome has one non-overlapping grid and remains readable when Project Rail is hidden.
